items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: George Wein called me... asked me if I would be interested in doing some gigs with him... I said, 'Yeah, sure, why not?' Work for him... I was just the added attraction for the week. So he hired me and Phil and a drummer to play a gig

ctx.x: No, not Charlie Bourgeois. An Englishman. I can't think of it... He was up in Boston when I first got in touch with George. In fact, he told me that he was responsible for me getting that tight with George.
